preconditions.description: The number of data centers n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of clients m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The day length h is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= uj < h for uj in u)
preconditions.description: Each maintenance hour uj for data center j is between 0 and h-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci1 <= n and 1 <= ci2 <= n and ci1 != ci2 for ci1, ci2 in clients)
preconditions.description: For each client, the indices of the two data centers storing their data are distinct and between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of data centers k to be included in the experiment is between 1 and n inclusive.
The list x contains exactly k distinct data center indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n for xi in x)
postconditions.description: Each data center index xi in x is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((u[ci1-1] + 1) % h != u[ci2-1] or (u[ci2-1] + 1) % h != u[ci1-1] for ci1, ci2 in clients)
postconditions.description: After shifting the maintenance time for the data centers in x by one hour, the data of any client is still accessible during any hour of the day.
